scientificStatus: Numerical proper-rotation group classification. Reflections and inversion are excluded here and belong to a separate full point-group classification. No exact symmetry or AC proof is inferred.

api.symbol: LaTeX group symbol; for example D_{5}.
api.label: Plain group label; for example D5.
api.order: Number of proper rotations, including identity; null for a continuous group.
api.degree: The n in C_n or D_n; null for polyhedral and continuous groups.
api.continuous: True for SO(2) and continuous D_infinity.
api.closureVerified: True only after checking the complete finite point-permutation action for identity, uniqueness and composition closure; null for continuous groups.

method.classification: Finite subgroups of SO(3) are cyclic, dihedral, tetrahedral, octahedral or icosahedral. The complete unoriented-axis orders distinguish these cases.

axisSignatures.C_n: One axis of order n (n>=2); C1 has no nonidentity axis.
axisSignatures.D_n: One n-fold axis and n twofold axes (n>=3). D2 has three twofold axes.

method.consistency: Every rotation order is checked against its point-permutation order. The sum of axis order minus1 must equal the nonidentity count. Element-order histograms must agree with those implied by the cyclic axis stabilizers. Nonclosed or inconsistent detections stay unclassified.
method.continuous: The supported nonempty collinear constellations have SO(2), or SO(2) semidirect C2 (denoted D_infinity) for equal antipodal weights. Empty or invalid data are not assigned SO(3).
method.convention: D_n has order2n. These are rotational groups, not the full groups containing mirror operations.

references.title: Pavel Etingof, Groups Around Us, Lecture5, Section10, Theorem10.2
references.scope: Classification of finite subgroups of SO(3). The axis signatures and implementation checks are derived and validated here.
